title: Finite-level site comparison of normalized vector-bundle integration
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient data of [def-pur-conventions], with $A=A_{E,n}$ and arbitrary $n\geq1$. Let $S$ be a finite-type $k$-scheme [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $\pi:V\to S$ be a vector bundle of constant rank $d\geq0$ with zero section, in the sense of [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. No separatedness of $S\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is assumed. For every scheme $T$ over $S$ write $C_T=\nu_T^*:D^+(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)\to D^+(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ for comparison pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Use constant discrete module sheaves and their ordinary etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], ordinary etale compact supports [def-amb-etale-compact-support], pro-etale compact supports [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], derived pullback and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the transported constructible exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Choose any $r\geq1$ with $\ell^r A=0$ and put
$$L_T=\mu^{\mathrm{et}}_{\ell^r,T}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/\ell^r}A_T,\qquad L_T(d)=L_T^{\otimes_A d}.$$
Here $\mu^{\mathrm{et}}_{\ell^r,T}$ is the sheaf of units $z$ satisfying $z^{\ell^r}=1$, with powers giving the $\mathbf Z/\ell^r$ action. The ordinary etale twist is as in [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]; the pro-etale twist remains the specified inverse-limit twist of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Let
$$\tau_T:C_TL_T\xrightarrow{\sim}A_T(1)$$
be the comparison induced by the inverse of projection from the roots-of-unity tower after scalar extension, as in [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map]. The maps $\tau_T$ and their tensor powers commute with inverse image along every morphism $w:T'\to T$ over $S$, identifying $Lw^*A_T(d)$ with $A_{T'}(d)$.

For $q:P=\mathbf P^1_S\to S$, write $b_q^e,h_q^e,t_q^e$ for the ordinary etale decomposition, Kummer class of $\mathcal O_P(1)$, and trace of [def-amb-p1-trace]. On the pro-etale site let $h_q^p:A_S\to Rq_{p,*}A_P(1)[2]$ be the adjoint of $A_P\to i_*A_S\xrightarrow{c_{H,A}}A_P(1)[2]$, where $i:S\hookrightarrow P$ is the infinity hyperplane $H$, with $\mathcal O_P(H)=\mathcal O_P(1)$, and $c_{H,A}$ is the supported class of [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map]. Let $b_q^p$ be the map with components the shifted twisted unit and $h_q^p$. With $\beta_q:C_SRq_{e,*}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rq_{p,*}C_P$ the canonical counit-mate comparison [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate], and $\tau$ and the finite direct-sum identifications understood, the actual maps satisfy
$$\beta_q C_S(b_q^e)=b_q^p.$$
In particular $b_q^p$ is invertible; with $t_q^p=\operatorname{pr}_2(b_q^p)^{-1}$ one has
$$t_q^p\beta_q=C_S(t_q^e),\qquad t_q^p h_q^p=1.$$
For $j:\mathbf A^1_S\hookrightarrow P$, the canonical comparison $C_Pj_!^e\cong j_!^p C_{\mathbf A^1_S}$ identifies the counit $j_!j^*\to1$ on the two sites. Together with $\beta_q$ it carries the restriction of $t_q^e$ by $Rq_*j_!\to Rq_*$ to the corresponding restriction of $t_q^p$.

Let $t_\pi^e:R\pi_!^e L_V(d)[2d]\to A_S$ be the vector-bundle integration of [def-amb-vector-integration], constructed on trivializing opens by ordered composition of these restricted projective-line traces [lem-amb-affine-space-top-trace]. On the pro-etale site form $t_\pi^p$ by the same local integrations using $t_q^p$, with the specified twists and canonical compact-support composition comparisons. These local maps agree on overlaps and define a global morphism. For the projective completion $V\xrightarrow{j_V}\overline V\xrightarrow{\overline\pi}S$, define the compact-support comparison to be the composite of the counit-mate proper direct-image comparison with the extension-by-zero comparison $e_{j_V}$ of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]:
$$C_SR\overline\pi_{e,*}j_{V!}^e\xrightarrow{\beta_{\overline\pi}}R\overline\pi_{p,*}C_{\overline V}j_{V!}^e\xrightarrow{R\overline\pi_{p,*}(e_{j_V})}R\overline\pi_{p,*}j_{V!}^pC_V.$$
Denote the resulting map by
$$\beta_\pi:C_SR\pi_!^e\xrightarrow{\sim}R\pi_!^p C_V$$
It identifies the actual global maps:
$$t_\pi^p\beta_\pi=C_S(t_\pi^e).$$
For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(S_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ (bounded constructible cohomology and finite Tor amplitude, the ordinary etale version of [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]), the same comparisons identify the canonical compact-support tensor projection maps, and the integration maps
$$a_K^e:R\pi_!^e(\pi_e^*K\otimes_A^L L_V(d)[2d])\xrightarrow{\operatorname{PF}}K\otimes_A^LR\pi_!^e L_V(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{1\otimes t_\pi^e}K$$
and $a_{C_SK}^p$ defined by the corresponding pro-etale formula. If $\eta_K^e$ is the adjoint transpose of $a_K^e$ under the ordinary etale compact-support adjunction, and $\eta_{C_SK}^p$ is the transpose of $a_{C_SK}^p$ under the bounded etale-origin adjunction, then
$$\eta_{C_SK}^p=C_V(\eta_K^e),$$
under $C_V(\pi_e^*K\otimes_A^LL_V(d)[2d])\cong L\pi_p^*C_SK(d)[2d]$ and $C_V\pi^{\times,e}K\cong R\pi^!C_SK$. The inverse of this transported map is the vector-bundle identification specified by [cor-pur-vector-bundle-purity]. All these comparisons are independent of the annihilating exponent $r$. No divisibility of $n$ by the ramification index, and no flatness of $A$ over $\mathbf Z/\ell^r$, is assumed.

proof.text: Use [lem-amb-finite-tate-site-descent] for the root-projection comparison, all pullbacks and exponent transitions, including $d=0$. The finite-type schemes are Noetherian by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian] (a field is Noetherian); [lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact] gives exactness of $C$. Thus the stipulated finite-level coefficients and bounded-below witnesses apply without flatness of $A$. The completed twistCompatibility proof unfolds the fixed twistComparison and projects the normalization, pullback and exponent-transition clauses of finite_tate_site_descent. The completed finiteTypeSiteComparison derives Noetherianity from the structure morphism, derives invertibility of ell from coefficientPrime_isUnit_stalk using the local unit criterion, and assembles the generic projective, integration and tensor comparison clauses without changing the coefficient index.

source.place: Tag 099R, section-comparison; projection from the roots-of-unity tower, as specified by lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map; agent-written naturality calculation

proof.text: For arbitrary Noetherian S with ell invertible, use lem-pur-supported-projective-chern-comparison to identify the supported infinity Chern arrow before adjunction. Prove the mate-adjunct equation from mate naturality and Mathlib unit_mateEquiv. The bounded directImage hom equals geoP1PushComparison by its Plus normalization (the private pushComparison_plus API of the proved GeoP1Cohomology module). Apply this to the shifted-line pullback and the ordinary Chern adjunct; constant-unit comparison identifies the latter with projectiveH. Comparison preserves biproducts, so the two component identities give the projective decomposition square. Cancel the compared ordinary decomposition and the supported decomposition inverse to get the trace equation. The second injection gives H followed by trace equal to the identity. Separately, the unchanged openCounitComparison transposes through the adjunction using the proved extension-unit mate normalization, naturality, and the triangle identities. No finite-field restriction is required for either clause.

source.place: Tag 0B65, mate unit/counit formulas; blueprint def-amb-p1-trace and supported Cartier Kummer comparison. Agent-written two-component biproduct and inverse calculation.

proof.text: Use orderedIntegration_comparison from [lem-pur-ordered-integration-comparison] on every trivializing open. Opens of a Noetherian scheme are Noetherian, and ell remains invertible there. Unfold localIntegration and chartPrefix: functoriality of comparison identifies each actual local trace with comparison of vectorIntegrationLocalTrace. Naturality of the canonical pullback comparison, followed by its constant-unit component, identifies the comparison of a normalized ordinary global integration with these local pro-etale traces. The actual ordinary vectorBundleIntegration has VectorIntegrationNormalization by existsUnique_vectorIntegrationGluing. Hence vectorSite.hom followed by its comparison has VectorNormalization. Uniqueness in existsUniqueVectorIntegration identifies this candidate with vectorIntegration. Cancel vectorSite.inv followed by vectorSite.hom to obtain the actual global trace comparison; the defining choose_spec gives its normalization clause. This is valid for every Noetherian base with ell invertible, including rank zero and the empty base. No separate finite-type affine-tower or frame-descent theorem is needed for this clause.

source.place: Whole proof: local normalized maps glue as degree-zero sheaf maps; uniqueness of the existing two global constructions. Agent-written comparison by naturality and the already proved ordered-integration comparison.

proof.text: For the tensor clause on every Noetherian base, use lem-pur-vector-tensor-projection-comparison to obtain boundedness and the actual projection isomorphisms with their comparison square. Define ae and ap by the prescribed inverse projections, tensors of the two normalized global traces and right unitors. The proved private tensor_integration_square cancels the ordinary projection inverse and pastes the tensor naturality square with the already proved global integration equality. This gives the integration square. Apply the proved generic boundedSiteTranspose_compatible calculation (without the finite-field restrictions of the public bounded-adjunction package) to obtain the transpose square with rho. The existing purityAtModulus gives ordinary_purity for the same pe, since its inverse determines it uniquely. Finally lem-pur-vector-tensor-ordinary-normalization gives the required normalized gamma identity with the explicit signed symmetry. No parent statement or definition is changed.

source.place: First two paragraphs; Stacks categories.tex Tag 0B65 for the adjunction transpose. Agent-written categorical pasting of the actual projection and trace equations.

proof.text: For vectorExponentIndependence, apply lem-pur-vector-local-trace-exponent on each frame. The proved private ordinary_integration_transition combines these equations with VectorIntegrationNormalization. Its uniqueness lemma uses fullness of the degree-zero single functor to write an arbitrary normalized derived morphism as the chosen gluing isomorphism followed by a sheaf map; uniqueness of the gluing pair identifies that map with the chosen one. This gives the ordinary global trace transition. Package the pulled-back baseExponentComparison as a morphism of bounded-below coefficients using vectorCoefficient_plus. Naturality of compactSupportSiteComparison gives its square. Cancel the comparison isomorphisms, use vectorIntegrationSiteComparison at the two exponents, and functoriality transports the ordinary equality to the stated pro-etale equality. These categorical calculations are complete Lean proofs.
